analyst.summary: Phoenix Mills is India's leading mall operator, and FY26 was a genuinely strong year -- record retail consumption, margin expansion, and profit growth, achieved without adding any new malls, i.e. real same-store strength rather than portfolio growth doing the work. Early FY27 trends (retail consumption +32% YoY in Q1) are even stronger. The balance sheet is comfortable (net debt/EBITDA ~1.2x) and the next wave of growth (Kolkata, Surat, Thane) is real but still 1-2 years from contributing. The concern is valuation: at roughly 61x trailing earnings against an ~11% return on equity, the stock is priced for continued flawless execution, leaving little room for error or for a slower year. We rate it a Hold -- a quality compounder, but not cheap enough here to add.
